versions.subject: Add posh_ps_sensitive_file_discovery
versions.detection:
selection_action:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - ls
        - get-childitem
        - gci
selection_recurse:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: '-recurse'
selection_file:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'pass'
        - 'kdbx'
condition: all of selection_*
